did.unittitle: Records of the NYU Daily Bulletin
did.abstract: The NYU Daily Bulletin was a student newspaper published every school day except Friday for the students of the School of Commerce and Washington Square College. Intended as a successor to the Square Daily, the short-lived publication ran for eight issues from April 25 to May 5, 1955. This collection consists of issues of the NYU Daily Bulletin from 1955.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This collection consists of issues of the NYU Daily Bulletin from 1955.

arrangement.head: Arrangement
arrangement.p: This collection has not been arranged by an archivist.

bioghist.p: The NYU Daily Bulletin was a student newspaper published every school day except Friday for the students of the School of Commerce and Washington Square College. Intended as a successor to the Square Daily, the short-lived publication ran for eight issues from April 25 to May 5, 1955.
